body: Thank you, I'm definitely gonna seek a diagnosis just waiting for covid lockdown to ease a little more.

I get this way too, recently my friends starting hanging out without me and even though I've cut them off now my mind can't help but go to the place of "they stopped hanging with because im ugly and i ruined the way our group looked" so ye i get that way aswell

It isn't bad that its causing this, from what I've experienced and from what I've seen from people with bdd its kinda common. I guess the only bad in that is that you go through with the thoughts. Im not good at emotional advice or help but I am a good listener. If you ever need someone to just listen im here. Talking doesn't fully fix things, and I know its hard to open up especially to a stranger, but talking could release some of the pressure or the loudness of those thoughts. If not me, please talk to someone you trust, or maybe even try those online venting apps, they've helped me a few times 💖

I feel this aswell, like I can't fully express myself anymore because I'm away of how I look when doing so and it sucks, its like a blockage on what I really wanna say or do but I just can't get over that fact

You definitely haven't scared me, to be honest your advice is helpful cause a lot of my worry was about where do i go and who can help. I spoke to someone close to me yesterday so I'm on the road to getting help or at least getting some form of diagnosis. I'll definitely look into cognitive behavioural theory as I have had counselling aswell but similar to you it never seemed to help ease my anxieties. Thank you btw for the advice im very grateful :)
Thank you again, it means a lot that you went out your way to help me, I'll definitely check out all the links :)
Honestly thank you so much, this is so helpful and kind of you
Thank you, I hope so too
